∀ {n T : Nat},
  LT.lt.{0} 0 T →
    ∀ (u : Real),
      LE.le.{0} 0 u →
        ∀ (x y : Fin n → Real) (e : Research.BlockDotProduct.RoundingErrors),
          Research.BlockDotProduct.Admissible u n T e →
            LT.lt.{0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑(HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} T (Research.BlockDotProduct.treeDepth n T))) u) 1 →
              ∃ Δx Δy,
                And
                  (Eq.{1} (Research.BlockDotProduct.computed T x y e)
                    (∑ i, HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (x i) (Δx i)) (y i)))
                  (And
                    (∀ (i : Fin n),
                      LE.le.{0} (abs.{0} (Δx i))
                        (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0}
                          (Research.BlockDotProduct.gamma u
                            (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} T (Research.BlockDotProduct.treeDepth n T)))
                          (abs.{0} (x i))))
                    (And
                      (Eq.{1} (Research.BlockDotProduct.computed T x y e)
                        (∑ i, HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (x i) (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (y i) (Δy i))))
                      (∀ (i : Fin n),
                        LE.le.{0} (abs.{0} (Δy i))
                          (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0}
                            (Research.BlockDotProduct.gamma u
                              (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} T (Research.BlockDotProduct.treeDepth n T)))
                            (abs.{0} (y i))))))
